how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form from the Banda district website: https://banda.nic.in, or collect it from the notice board of the BSA office.
Fill the application form clearly by hand; overwriting and cutting are not acceptable.
Fill in the candidate's name, father's/husband's name, and date of birth exactly as recorded in the High School certificate.
Attach self-attested photocopies of all required educational, training, and category certificates.
Mention a valid mobile number and email ID, since all counselling and verification communication will be sent only to these.
Submit a separate application for each post applied for.
Write the post name and subject applied for on the top of the envelope, and enclose a second, self-addressed envelope with a ₹58 postage stamp.
Send the completed application only by registered post to: Office of the District Basic Education Officer, Civil Lines, Banda, Banda District, Uttar Pradesh - PIN 210001.
Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 9 August 2026, by 5:00 PM. Applications received after the due date, or through any other medium, will not be accepted.
important_instructions: Candidates must possess the exact qualification prescribed for the post they are applying for. The district selection committee reserves the right to change, amend, or cancel the notification at any time; no legal claim will be entertained regarding this. No travel allowance will be paid for attending counselling or interview. Incomplete, unsigned, or improperly formatted applications, or applications sent by ordinary post, will be rejected without consideration. No additional documents will be accepted at the time of counselling beyond those already attached with the application. Selected candidates will be engaged on a contract basis for 11 months and 29 days for the academic session; the contract may be renewed for the next session subject to satisfactory performance and approval of the District Magistrate. Care Taker, Peon, Watchman, and Assistant Cook posts are full-time, and residence at the school is compulsory. A medical fitness certificate from the Chief Medical Officer (CMO) will be required after selection. Women dismissed from service or convicted of a moral/character offence are not eligible for selection.

Candidates interested in similar teaching and non-teaching roles can also explore more Uttar Pradesh Government Jobs and UP Basic Shiksha Vibhag Recruitment updates. Those looking for PGT and teaching positions can check the latest PGT Teacher Recruitment notifications across other districts. Candidates applying for support staff roles can also browse Peon, Chowkidar & Class IV Government Jobs and Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya Recruitment openings in other districts of Uttar Pradesh.

content_sections.heading: KGBV Banda Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Office of the District Basic Education Officer (Zila Basic Shiksha Adhikari), Banda, Uttar Pradesh, has officially released the KGBV Banda Recruitment 2026 notification dated 25.07.2026 for the recruitment of 77 vacancies under Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalayas (KGBVs). The notification includes posts such as Principal, PGT Teachers, Computer Science Teacher, Care Taker, Lab Assistant, Office Superintendent/Clerk, Assistant Cook, Peon, and Watchman for the 2026–27 academic session. It contains complete details regarding post-wise vacancies, eligibility criteria, age limit, educational qualifications, salary, selection process, reservation, required documents, and the offline application procedure. Eligible women candidates are advised to read the official notification carefully before submitting their application in the prescribed format. Download KGBV Banda Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PD F KGBV Banda Recruitment 2026 official Website

content_sections.heading: KGBV Banda Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only women candidates can apply; all posts are reserved for female applicants. Candidates convicted of a moral/character offence, dismissed from any service, or declared insolvent are not eligible. Candidates with physical disability, contagious disease, or serious illness are not eligible for the Care Taker, Peon, Watchman and Assistant Cook posts, since night stay at the school is compulsory for these roles. Maximum age for continued service in a Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya is 60 years.

content_sections.text: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification. content_sections.heading: KGBV Banda Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for teaching and academic posts (Principal, PGT subjects, Care Taker) is made on the basis of a merit/weightage score calculated as follows: If two or more candidates have equal merit marks, the older candidate (by age) is ranked higher. If merit marks and age are both equal, ranking is done alphabetically by name (English alphabetical order). Selection for Assistant Cook, Peon, and Watchman posts is made through an interview . All submitted certificates are verified with the concerned board/institution before final selection; original documents are kept safe at the District Project Office.

Write the post name and subject applied for on the top of the envelope, and enclose a second, self-addressed envelope with a ₹58 postage stamp. Send the completed application only by registered post to: Office of the District Basic Education Officer, Civil Lines, Banda, Banda District, Uttar Pradesh - PIN 210001. Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 9 August 2026, by 5:00 PM . Applications received after the due date, or through any other medium, will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q1. Who can apply for KGBV Banda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only women candidates meeting the prescribed educational qualification and age limit for the respective post can apply.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for KGBV Banda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application by registered post is 9 August 2026, up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for KGBV Banda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the notification. Candidates only need to enclose a self-addressed envelope with a ₹58 postage stamp.

faq.question: Q4. Can I apply online for KGBV Banda posts?
faq.answer: No. Applications must be submitted offline, by registered post only, to the Office of the District Basic Education Officer, Civil Lines, Banda.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for KGBV Banda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Minimum age is 30 years for Principal and 25 years for all other posts; the maximum age is 45 years for all posts, calculated as on 1 April 2026.

faq.question: Q6. How many total vacancies are there in KGBV Banda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 77 total vacancies across 14 posts, comprising 72 new posts in the 4 newly upgraded KGBVs and 5 previously vacant posts at Mahua and Kamasin KGBVs.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for KGBV Banda teaching posts?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a weighted merit score calculated from High School, Intermediate, Graduation, Postgraduate, and Training qualification marks. Care Taker, Peon, Watchman, and Assistant Cook posts are selected through interview.
